title: Retry VCF Installer depot token updates idempotently
prompt:
Implement the exported `Set-VcfInstallerDepotToken` function in `src/VcfInstaller.Depot/VcfInstaller.Depot.psm1`.

Before implementing, research the VCF Installer 9.1 `updateDepotSettings` operation and its generated VMware VCF PowerCLI binding in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

`VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` version `13.5.0.25380678` is installed. Use `Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotAccount`, `Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotSettings`, and `Invoke-VcfInstallerUpdateDepotSettings` rather than a direct HTTP client. Build one online VMware depot representation and reuse that same representation for every attempt of the idempotent `updateDepotSettings` PUT. `DownloadToken` is required. Add `downloadActivationCode` only when the caller actually bound `DownloadActivationCode`. All other optional `DepotAccount` and `DepotSettings` fields must remain unset and therefore be omitted from the JSON wire body: do not send `username`, `password`, `status`, `message`, `offlineAccount`, `depotConfiguration`, nulls, empty strings, zeroes, or false placeholders.

`RetryCount` is the number of retries after the first attempt. Retry HTTP 408, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, and ambiguous transport failures with no HTTP status, but do not retry other HTTP 4xx responses. `RetryDelaySeconds=0` must be supported. Return the successful SDK response and rethrow the final or non-retryable error unchanged. Keep the existing public function signature and module manifest compatible.

Do not use `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, `WebClient`, `HttpClient`, curl, or another direct HTTP client. Do not vendor, replace, or intercept the VMware prerequisite. Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`.
